licenseExceptions.rationale: Transitive Mermaid color utility used only to render repository-authored diagrams; package metadata omits the repository's license declaration.
Transitive Crawlee process-tree utility; Sentinel does not expose it as a library or distribute a modified copy. Replace when Crawlee removes the legacy dependency.

dependencyExceptions.rationale: No patched adm-zip release exists as of review. The package is transitive browser-header generation data; Sentinel never calls it to extract target repositories or uploaded archives, and target source is fetched as bounded Git objects.

Crawlee 3.18.1 requires stream-json 1.x. Sentinel does not call the affected filter primitives on attacker-controlled nested JSON and independently caps documentation bytes/pages/time. A forced 3.x override would cross an unverified major API boundary.

secretExceptions.rationale: Exact synthetic GitHub token used to verify installation-token redaction; it is not a valid credential.
Exact synthetic token prefix used to generate deterministic token-refresh fixtures; it is not a valid credential.
Exact synthetic GitHub token used to test metadata error redaction; it is not a valid credential.
Exact synthetic GitHub token used to test source identity redaction; it is not a valid credential.
Private-key header without key material is a fixed redaction test vector, not a usable key.
OpenSSH private-key header without key material is a fixed redaction test vector, not a usable key.
Exact AWS-shaped alphabetic test vector verifies redaction and is not a provisioned credential.
